declarations.description: A button that starts an action or submits a form.

cssProperties.description: Space before and after the text.
cssProperties.name: --va-button-padding-inline

slots.description: The button's text. This is its accessible name unless `label` is set.
An icon before the text. Mark decorative icons `aria-hidden="true"`.
slots.name: start

members.name: variant
members.description: Visual emphasis. Use one `primary` button per view.

members.name: size
members.description: Height and text size. Every size meets the 24px WCAG 2.2 target size.

members.name: type
members.description:
What the button does in a form. Defaults to `button`, unlike the native `<button>`,
so a button never submits a form by accident. Set `type="submit"` to submit.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the button. It cannot be focused or activated.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows a spinner and blocks activation, but keeps the button focusable.

members.name: name
members.description: Submitted with the form as `name=value` when this button submits it.

members.name: value
members.description: Submitted with `name` when this button submits the form.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name. Required when the button has no text, such as an icon-only button.

members.name: form
members.description: The form this button belongs to, if any.

events.description: The native click event. Not fired while `disabled` or `loading`.
events.name: click

declarations.summary: Starts an action, or submits or resets the form it is in.

x-keyboard.description: Moves focus to the next control. A disabled button is skipped.

notes: `loading` keeps the button focusable, sets `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy`, and adds "Loading" to its name.
x-a11y.name: The slotted text, or the `label` attribute. A button with only an icon must have `label`.

x-guidance.use: For an action on the current page (Save, Delete, Open dialog) or to submit a form.
x-guidance.avoid: For navigation to another page or URL.

x-examples.title: Variants
x-examples.description: One primary action per view; secondary and ghost for the rest; danger for destructive actions.
x-examples.code:
<va-button>Save changes</va-button>
<va-button variant="secondary">Cancel</va-button>
<va-button variant="ghost">Learn more</va-button>
<va-button variant="danger">Delete project</va-button>

x-examples.title: Sizes
x-examples.description: Every size meets the WCAG 2.2 target size of 24 by 24 pixels.

x-examples.title: Disabled and loading
x-examples.description: Disabled buttons can't be focused. Loading buttons stay focusable, so the user keeps their place.

x-examples.title: With icons
x-examples.description: Decorative icons are aria-hidden. An icon-only button needs label.
x-examples.code:
<va-button variant="secondary">
  <svg slot="start" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>
  New article
</va-button>
<va-button variant="ghost" label="Close">
  <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>
</va-button>

x-examples.title: In a form
x-examples.description: type="submit" submits the form with name=value; the default type="button" never submits.
x-examples.code:
<form>
  <label>Email <input name="email" type="email" value="ada@example.com"></label>
  <va-button type="submit" name="intent" value="subscribe">Subscribe</va-button>
  <va-button type="reset" variant="secondary">Reset</va-button>
</form>

declarations.name: define
declarations.description: Defines a custom element once. A second definition of the same tag is a no-op, not an error.

declarations.name: DEV_MODE
declarations.description:
True in the development build, false in the production build.
build.js rewrites this file in dist/prod so bundlers drop every dev-only branch.

declarations.description: The shared keyboard focus ring: visible only for keyboard focus, drawn outside the control.

Base class for Vastu form controls. It joins the control to its `<form>` through
ElementInternals, so the control submits, resets, disables and validates like a native one.
Subclasses call `setFormValue()` and `setValidity()`; everything else is handled here.
declarations.name: FormControl

declarations.description:
Logs a development-only warning written for people and agents alike:

Warns once per page if no Vastu brand stylesheet is loaded. Waits for the page's load event,
so a stylesheet that is still downloading doesn't cause a false warning.
